p.s: TO: Leader of the group of American students
FROM:
SUBJECT: Recomnendations of a place to visit
INTRODUCTION:
The aim of this report is to give description and recommendation of the most interesting building in the town.
GENERAL INFORMATION:
The place I would like to recommend is the seventienth-century Royal Palace.
It is situated in a heart of Warsaw and surrounded by the buildings of an Old Town.
There is a square old Market with the magnificent statue of the King Zygmunt, in the centre of it.
FACILITIES:
Inside the Palace, there is a museum of an antique collection of porcalaine.
There is also a Portrait Gallery in the left wing of the Palace.
The Old Town is the best place for afternoon stroll with a great deal of restaurants, caffes and street performers.
There is an easy reach to cashpoints, lavatories, emergency services, etc.
POSITIVE POINTS
It is easy to get there by any sort of public transport
There are numbers of hotels or youth hostels to stay overninight, if necessary
Most of the admissions are absolutely free.
NEGATIVE POINTS
A part of the Palace might be closed, due to the constant renovations.
All the facilities are usually overcrowded during a summer holiday.
CONCLUSION:
Despite the few drawbacks, I would strongly recommend the Royal Palace as the most suitable place to visit for the foreign students.
